authorization: Audit the whole app in five rounds; fix confirmed defects and publish the verified product without further approval prompts.

scope.product: Current HEWRS application, its reachable review/wardrobe/photo interfaces, generation and rule layers, persistent data, rendered assets, build and publication chain
scope.special_focus: All 50 registered shirt identities, photo identity, No Tie/tied collars, source provenance, same-ID rendering across suit/blazer/shirt-only routes
scope.repository_inventory: Every tracked code file is inventoried. Historical snapshots, generated duplicates and inactive entrypoints are identified explicitly; they are not silently treated as current runtime source.
scope.data_boundary: Synthetic test profiles only; no owner browser data is accessed or reset. Original identities, approved source images, stored scores and historical records remain authoritative.

rounds.name: Independent rule, data and asset verification
Adversarial state, concurrency and failure review
Final cross-review, regressions and live publication

closure_rule: Every confirmed material defect requires a repair and a regression result. Remaining limitations and unverified boundaries must be stated explicitly; a pass count is not proof of universal correctness.
